stemMd: What additional problem was found near the rear seats?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The room had no ventilation system.

options.label: C
options.textMd: A complete absence of sound-absorbing panels at the front.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Steady noise from a ventilation unit.

explanationMd: The rear-seat difficulty was linked to a steady ventilation noise. This was a different acoustic factor from reverberation. The initial intervention could therefore work as measured while leaving another obstacle.

distractorRationale.c: The panels had improved front-area speech clarity.
distractorRationale.a: The passage accepts the measured reverberation improvement.
distractorRationale.b: A ventilation unit was the identified noise source.
